description: This file defines classes and methods for managing bank statements, statement lines, and reconciliation in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including calculations of balances, currency handling, and confirmation/cancellation workflows.

classes.name: account_bank_statement
classes.description: Model for managing bank statements, including default values, balance calculations, confirmation, cancellation, and copying.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile
classes.description: Model for handling reconciliation of bank statement lines, including total calculations and default values.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_reconcile_line
classes.description: Model for individual reconciliation lines, typically for write-offs.

classes.name: account_bank_statement_line
classes.description: Model for individual bank statement lines, including onchange handlers for partner and reconciliation amount calculations.

methods.name: _default_journal_id
methods.description: Returns default journal ID from context if available.

methods.name: _default_balance_start
methods.description: Fetches the latest starting balance for a journal.

methods.name: _end_balance
methods.description: Calculates the ending balance of a bank statement considering move lines and statement lines.

methods.name: _get_period
methods.description: Retrieves the current accounting period.

methods.name: _currency
methods.description: Determines the currency for a bank statement, defaulting to journal or company currency.

methods.name: button_confirm
methods.description: Confirms a bank statement, creating accounting moves and reconciling lines.

methods.name: button_cancel
methods.description: Cancels a confirmed bank statement, deleting associated moves.

methods.name: onchange_journal_id
methods.description: Updates starting balance and currency when journal is changed.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes draft statements; prevents deletion of confirmed ones.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of a statement with cleared move lines.

methods.name: _total_entry
methods.description: Calculates total debit minus credit for reconciliation lines.

methods.name: _total_new
methods.description: Calculates total amount of new reconciliation lines.

methods.name: _total_balance
methods.description: Calculates total balance considering new, entry, and amount.

methods.name: _total_amount
methods.description: Computes total amount in the company's currency for reconciliation.

methods.name: _default_amount
methods.description: Provides default amount based on current context.

methods.name: _total_currency
methods.description: Returns the currency ID for reconciliation, defaulting to company currency.

methods.name: _default_currency
methods.description: Provides default currency ID from user's company.

methods.name: _total_second_amount
methods.description: Returns amount in the second currency (e.g., journal currency).

methods.name: _total_second_currency
methods.description: Returns the second currency ID used in reconciliation.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Generates display name for reconciliation records, including total and currency.

methods.name: onchange_partner_id
methods.description: Updates account and amount based on selected partner.

methods.name: _reconcile_amount
methods.description: Calculates the amount reconciled in the statement line.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes draft statements and associated moves.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Duplicates a statement with cleared move lines.
